notes: Medium (total 6). Single-stage: parse a CSV point cloud (comments, blanks, padded fields, negatives), apply a closed bounding-box filter with inclusive max edges, bin into an (ny, nx) grid with row=y / col=x orientation, and normalize by the in-box total so the grid sums to 1.0 (all-zero grid in the empty case). reasoning_depth=1 for the edge-inclusive bin-index/clamp and orientation logic; debugging_ambiguity=1 for the row/column convention; adversarial_inputs=1 and hidden_case_generalization=1 (three distinct hidden clouds including an empty in-box case and a 1x1 grid); quantitative_correctness=2 because the grader compares every grid cell to 1e-9 plus the totals and grid_sum. No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to medium.
